newsitem.title: USA: Forest Oil says Gulf output up.
newsitem.headline: Forest Oil says Gulf output up.

text.p: Forest Oil Corp on Thursday said its Eugene Island Block 53 No.10 exploratory well was now flowing at 25.0 million cubic feet of natural gas and 979 barrels of condensate at 3,390 pounds per square inch flowing tubing pressure through a 35/64 inch choke.
The producing zone is between 13,087 feet and 13,282 feet.
The company said that output could rise, but is constrained by production infrastructure.
"Forest is currently drilling an offset well (100% wi) to test similar structures in different fault blocks on Eugene Island Block 53," it said.
It also said acid treatment at its High Island Block 116 B-1 well had increased output to 57.4 million cubic feet of natural gas and 1,011 barrels of condensate per day.
